hints.title: First Appearance Tracking
hints.text: Keep track of the index where each distinct letter first appears in string s.

hints.title: Distance Verification
hints.text: When the letter appears the second time at index i, compute the number of characters between them as i - first_index - 1.

hints.title: Expected Distance Comparison
hints.text: Compare the computed difference with distance[ord(c) - ord('a')]. If any character mismatches, return false.

hints.title: First Appearance Map Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking at most 26 lowercase alphabet positions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested search for each letter's pair takes O(n^2) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed-size 26-element array or hash map provides O(1) lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Verifies distance formula (i - first - 1) on second character occurrence in single pass.
